title: ST-Lite: Training-Free KV Cache Compression with Spatio-Trajectory Guidance for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2603.00188v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training-free KV cache compression is essential for deploying vision-language GUI agents under memory and latency constraints, yet existing methods are designed for generic language workloads and ignore the distinctive structure of GUI interaction traces. We characterize three GUI-specific workload properties--high inter-frame visual redundancy, extremely small UI-element spatial footprints, and near-uniform cross-layer attention sparsity--that cause existing schemes to retain as few as 39% of oracle-important KV pairs at the standard 20% budget. To address this, we propose ST-Lite, a training-free compression scheme whose three components each target one property: Trajectory-aware Semantic Gating (TSG) filters redundant historical frames, Component-centric Spatial Saliency (CSS) preserves fine-grained element boundaries, and a flat per-layer budget avoids hierarchical misallocation. translated_title: ST-Lite：基于时空轨迹引导的无训练KV缓存压缩，用于长程图形用户界面代理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.00188v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：无训练KV缓存压缩对于在内存和延迟约束下部署视觉语言图形用户界面代理至关重要，然而现有方法针对通用语言工作负载设计，忽略了图形用户界面交互轨迹的独特结构。我们刻画了三个图形用户界面特定的工作负载特性——高帧间视觉冗余、极小的UI元素空间足迹，以及近乎均匀的跨层注意力稀疏性——这些特性导致现有方案在标准20%预算下仅能保留约39%的预言机重要KV对。为解决此问题，我们提出ST-Lite，一种无训练压缩方案，其三个组件分别针对一个特性：轨迹感知语义门控（TSG）过滤冗余历史帧，组件中心空间显著性（CSS）保留细粒度元素边界，以及平坦的逐层预算避免层级分配不均。在七个图形用户界面基准和两个骨干网络上，我们验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出ST-Lite，一种无训练KV缓存压缩方案，针对GUI交互轨迹的高视觉冗余、小UI元素足迹和均匀注意力稀疏性三个特性，分别采用轨迹感知语义门控、组件中心空间显著性和平坦逐层预算，在七个GUI基准上显著提升压缩效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ST-Lite, a training-free KV cache compression scheme that addresses three GUI-specific workload properties—high visual redundancy, tiny UI element footprints, and uniform attention sparsity—via trajectory-aware semantic gating, component-centric spatial saliency, and flat per-layer budgeting, significantly improving compression efficiency across seven GUI benchmarks.
